children: Jones Ventures INTL Acquisition1 announced that holders may separately trade Class A ordinary shares and rights starting September 3, 2026.
Units from the IPO can be separated beginning Sept 3, 2026, allowing independent trading of shares and rights.
Each Unit contains one Class A ordinary share and one Share Right to receive 1/8 of a Class A ordinary share.
No fractional rights will be issued upon separation; only whole rights will trade on Nasdaq.
Separated Class A shares and Rights expected to trade under symbols JONE and JONER; unsplit Units remain JONEU.
Holders must contact the transfer agent, VStock Transfer, LLC, via their brokers to effect separation.
